# Phase One — Boundless Completion

The Awtsmoos recreates the whole product universe every instant; this wave closes the remaining backend truth, workflow continuity, performance, accessibility, monetization quality, and audit gaps without sacrificing correctness for speed.

## Parallel completion rails
- Close the post-split Wallet reconciliation gate and add only a safe authenticated current-account health surface.
- Trace and reduce eager startup module-loading cost without moving required readiness work after HTTP bind.
- Discover and implement a reusable cross-product handoff primitive from existing share/export/import conventions.
- Audit and strengthen shared accessibility/performance on commerce, catalog, and retention surfaces.
- Audit Games monetization for cosmetic/content/convenience value without pay-to-win mechanics.
- Audit creator/developer Apps for fulfillment-backed compute/storage/automation premium value.
- Re-run the full release baseline after every shared/global write wave.
- Re-read every touched file and write planned-versus-actual evidence before declaring completion.

## Absolute rules
- Whole-file rewrites only.
- Exact B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed be He header on touched JS/MJS.
- Tabs only, generous newlines, no minification.
- Every touched JS/MJS strictly under 120 lines.
- Extensive JSDoc and Awtsmoos/Awtsmoos.com commentary.
- Do not expose cross-account economic data without a proven operator authorization model.
- Do not claim revenue guarantees.
